statement.zh-TW: 能把一筆現金收付歸入營業、投資或籌資活動
statement.en: Put a cash receipt or payment into operating, investing or financing activities

text.zh-TW: 把借款收到的現金當成營業活動的流入
text.en: Treating cash received from a loan as an operating inflow

text.zh-TW: 以為買設備付的錢是營業活動，因為設備是用來做生意的
text.en: Thinking cash paid for equipment is operating because the equipment is used in the business

text.zh-TW: 把股東出資當成公司賺到的錢
text.en: Treating capital from shareholders as money the company earned

text.zh-TW: 不知道課程把付利息列在營業活動，以為一定要和還本金一樣列在籌資活動
text.en: Not realising the course places interest paid under operating activities, and assuming it must sit with loan repayments under financing

statement.zh-TW: 能說明間接法怎麼把損益表的利益換算成營業活動的現金：哪些沒有付現的費用要還原、營運資金的增減怎麼調整，以及本課為什麼以稅前淨利當起點
statement.en: Explain how the indirect method converts profit on the income statement into operating cash: which non-cash expenses are reversed, how working-capital changes are adjusted, and why this course takes profit before tax as the starting point

text.zh-TW: 以為折舊加回來是因為公司收到了一筆錢
text.en: Thinking depreciation is added back because the company received cash

text.zh-TW: 以為間接法只能從稅前淨利起算，從本期淨利起算是錯的
text.en: Thinking the indirect method may only start from profit before tax and that starting from profit for the period is wrong

text.zh-TW: 以為營業活動的現金流量就是稅前淨利
text.en: Thinking cash from operating activities is simply profit before tax

statement.zh-TW: 能判斷應收帳款、存貨與應付帳款的增減，會讓營業活動的現金變多還是變少
statement.en: Judge whether a change in trade receivables, inventories or trade payables makes operating cash higher or lower

text.zh-TW: 以為應收帳款增加代表收到更多錢
text.en: Thinking an increase in trade receivables means more cash was collected

text.zh-TW: 以為應付帳款增加會讓現金減少，因為欠的錢變多了
text.en: Thinking an increase in trade payables reduces cash because more is owed

text.zh-TW: 以為賒購存貨會讓營業活動的現金減少
text.en: Thinking inventory bought on credit reduces operating cash

statement.zh-TW: 能解釋「有獲利卻缺現金」與「虧損卻有現金」各是怎麼發生的
statement.en: Explain how a company can be profitable yet short of cash, or loss-making yet have cash to spare

text.zh-TW: 以為有賺錢的公司不可能付不出錢
text.en: Thinking a profitable company cannot run short of cash

text.zh-TW: 以為帳上現金變多就代表這一期有賺錢
text.en: Thinking a rise in cash means the period was profitable

text.zh-TW: 以為虧損的公司一定沒有現金
text.en: Thinking a loss-making company must have no cash

text.zh-TW: 以為提列折舊會讓現金變少
